items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And so when I got there for the second Benny Carter band... And I stayed on with Benny Carter and Eddie Beall, at the same place.

ctx.x: Little boy called Keg Parnell. He used to work with Benny Carter, that's the time that Eddie Heywood was with him. [PAUSE]
July 7, 1976. John, we just played back what we recorded so far, and I think there were a couple of things you wanted to correct, right?
